reference_sql:
WITH lead_steps AS (  -- one row per lead created in the period, with its opportunity if any
  SELECT l.email, o.opportunity_id, o.is_won
  FROM leads l
  LEFT JOIN opportunities o ON o.lead_id = l.lead_id
  WHERE l.created_at >= TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01 00:00:00' AND l.created_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01 00:00:00'
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT email) AS contacts,
       COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN opportunity_id IS NOT NULL THEN email END) AS with_opportunity,
       COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN is_won THEN email END) AS won,
       1.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN is_won THEN email END) / COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN opportunity_id IS NOT NULL THEN email END) AS win_rate
FROM lead_steps
alternatives:
WITH contacts AS (  -- one row per email with a lead created in 2025, 1 or 0 for each later step
  SELECT l.email,
         MAX(CASE WHEN o.opportunity_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_opportunity,
         MAX(CASE WHEN o.is_won THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_won
  FROM leads l
  LEFT JOIN opportunities o ON o.lead_id = l.lead_id
  WHERE l.created_at >= TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01 00:00:00' AND l.created_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01 00:00:00'
  GROUP BY l.email
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS contacts, SUM(has_opportunity) AS with_opportunity, SUM(has_won) AS won,
       1.0 * SUM(has_won) / SUM(has_opportunity) AS win_rate
FROM contacts

other_way.tradeoff: One row per email with 0 or 1 flags makes each step a plain sum, at the cost of one extra step.

  SELECT l.email, o.opportunity_id, o.is_won
  FROM leads l
  LEFT JOIN opportunities o ON o.lead_id = l.lead_id
  WHERE l.created_at >= TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01 00:00:00' AND l.created_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01 00:00:00'
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT email) AS contacts,
       COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN opportunity_id IS NOT NULL THEN email END) AS with_opportunity,
       COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN is_won THEN email END) AS won,
       1.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN is_won THEN email END) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN opportunity_id IS NOT NULL THEN email END), 0) AS win_rate
FROM lead_steps
